settings.settings_source: reuse, new: the cell's items (P2.43 done_when; E214's and E226's known-answer items: E195's four reuse items and E214's two built new edits); split_seed: E226's (experiments/kstar_vpd/results/predictions.json), so the halves are drawn the same way; control_state: E211's positive control (experiments/realistic_tasks/run2.py ctl), the one state whose share, k_half, r_half numerator and erank are all saved. The share, k_half and erank settings are E211's and E98's as filed (E98's k_grid, batch, gain_floor 1, carry_floor 0.1 read from experiments/neuron_r/results/predictions.json at run time)

thresholds.thresholds_source: gate_tol: E214's and E226's filed gate_tol (relative logit error), here guarding that M plus the item's weight change is F (same arithmetic, so 0 expected; a miss is a code error); reproduce_tol: E211's filed values (experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run2.json, from E143's measured re-read floor; E211 read share 0.7538 against 0.7519 saved, k_half 16 = 16, r_half_num and erank equal to 1e-13); band_min share: E161's batch sd of the share (experiments/share_stability/results/run.json .stage1_step10.sd_r), k_half: one grid step in log2 units (P2.24 card's smallest gap, ~/commute-data/cards/E190.md and experiments/k_half_fill/card.md); both used only when the measured split-half band is degenerate

directions.share: higher = more reuse. The share is the part of the gain that the original subcomponents carry once Gamma re-gates them on the new activations (GOALS.md Terms, r); re-gating existing parts is the reuse reading (the fixed-shift hypothesis, GOALS.md Terms), and E211 filed '+' for it on every LM pair
directions.k_half: fewer neurons = more reuse, read as -log2 k_half. P2.24's card (experiments/k_half_fill/card.md) rival a: 'the reuse side recruits fewer upstream neurons to re-fire than the new side'; E211 filed the same ('fewer neurons carry the reuse side')
directions.erank: higher = more reuse. E141's filed P3 (experiments/update_svd/results/predictions.json: 'the side built to reuse has the higher rank'); E141's pair rule itself did not use the sign and E211 filed the opposite sign on its label pairs, so the reversed order is reported beside it (reversed_gap) and not scored

new_few.gain: over 5 (E214: lookup top-1 0.90 from M's near 0)
new_few.share: 0.0 to 0.3: the answer y_i is written by a new output column on eight slot neurons, which no original subcomponent writes
new_few.erank: 4 to 8 (rank-8 changes of block 0's c_fc and down_proj)

new_thin.k_half: 64 to 1024 (a least-norm change of every down_proj column of block 0)

x2.gain: under 1 (KL(F || M) 0.10 per position, E214), so share nan and k_half null
x2.erank: 4 to 8 (eight columns of block 1's down_proj scaled; equal to x10's: erank does not see the factor)

moved.reading: does not apply for every method: F appends eight neurons M lacks, so it is not a weight change of M's 24 matrices

rebuilt.gain: about 0 (built to restore M's behaviour; KL(F || M) 0.12), so share nan and k_half null

expected.verdict: P1 'not read' for all three methods (moved); P1b 'not read' for the share and k_half (x2 and rebuilt under the gain floor) and pass or fail for erank by whether x2's rank beats both new edits'; expected: no method passes either rule (rival b), low confidence

P0 (stops).rule: exit 1 unless, in stage 0, first and alone: (a) the control state read by these readers reproduces each saved value within reproduce_tol (share, k_half exactly, r_half numerator, erank); (b) the do-nothing item (E214's do_nothing, a copy of M, on E214's cue windows after the edits are built) reads share numerator, gain, r_half numerator and G exactly 0, k_half null and erank null; then per item (c) M plus the item's weight change gives F's logits at the read position within gate_tol.
P0 (stops).blind_to: whether any reading means reuse; they check that the readers are E211's and that each item is the change E214 built
P0 (stops).positive_control: (a) a saved state read by the same functions

band.rule: per method, band = max over the six items of |m(half 1) - m(half 2)| (m oriented as in 'directions'; halves of each item's rows by split_seed, each half read on its own); an item unreadable on either half is left out. Degenerate (no finite gap, or all 0): band = band_min. erank: band = 0 (a function of the weight change alone, no rows).
band.absolute_or_relative: absolute, in each method's own oriented units (share; log2 neurons; erank)

P1 (labels recovered, all reuse items).rule: per method: min over x2, x10, moved, rebuilt - max over new_few, new_thin of the oriented reading (all rows) > band, strictly: 'pass'; all six finite and not: 'fail'; any of the six unreadable (share nan at gain under 1, k_half null, erank null, or the item 'does not apply'): 'not read', listing the items. A method passes only on 'pass'; 'not read' is reported as not passing, naming what it cannot read (the definition must read every case, user 2026-11-13).
P1 (labels recovered, all reuse items).edge_cases: empty side or an unreadable item: 'not read'; ties: strict, a tie fails; zero denominator: the share is nan below a gain of 1 (and at 0), k_half is null when r_half is not above carry_floor or its numerator is not positive, so 'not read'; the do-nothing state is on neither side and every method reads it as unreadable, so a set of do-nothing items is 'not read' and cannot pass; moved is a change M's 24 matrices cannot hold, so P1 is 'not read' for every method by construction (as E226's R1 for R, where moved's grafts score 0)

P1b (labels recovered, moved left out).rule: P1 with x2, x10, rebuilt as the reuse side (E226's R1b). The cell's answer paragraph names the methods with 'pass' on P1b and on P1.

rules.reported, not scored: the reversed gap (min new - max reuse) per method; every item's gain, share numerator, r_half, G, norm2; the halves' readings

blind_to.share: a change whose gain is under 1 log-odds (it reads nan), and any change that is not a weight change of M's 24 matrices; it reads only the trained answer at one position
blind_to.k_half: the same gain floor; a change whose re-firing carries 10% or less of the gain (null); which neurons carry the gain, only how many
blind_to.erank: the task and the model's behaviour altogether: it is the spectrum of the weight change, the same at x2 and x10

time_and_memory: model load and E214's world about 1 min (E214/E226 logs); the edit build and the do-nothing about 2.5 min (E226 rehearsal 61964, its stage 0); per item about 60 s for the share and k_half on all rows and both halves (E211's whole reader set read a 500-row state in about 58 s on an L40, job 61448, of which the share and k_half are a part); six items plus the control about 8 min: about 12-15 min in all; peak GPU about 10 GB (E226 rehearsal 10.3 GB at x10), host under 10 GB (E211 ctl 6.1 GB)
